title: Agent role templates
intro: Shared teaching examples: inspect each goal, its skills and handoff, then adapt an unsaved configuration. These are instructions, not installed autonomous agents.
recipe_help: Researcher → bilingual editor → SEO reviewer → campaign planner. Support and operations roles handle separate supplied evidence. A person copies or connects the reviewed output to the next task; choosing these templates does not create an automatic workflow.
boundaries: Private drafts only. Skills do not grant access. Existing canvas context, owner permissions and explicit review still apply. No automatic publishing, scheduling, messaging, SSH or Metricool actions.
setup_help: Select your existing agent. The next page previews replacement skills without saving; you choose MCP references yourself and review before Save. The model remains unchanged and can be configured separately.
no_keys: No active agent key owned by you is available. Create a deliberately scoped key through the existing key setup first. This template never creates one.
manager: You can inspect these shared examples. Applying them and viewing saved connection metadata require key and settings management permissions.
inputs: Inputs: approved, sanitized source text and an explicit task supplied in the canvas.
output: Output: a private text draft or checklist for the next human review.
requirements: Choose an external client or an existing managed AI profile for text generation. Source text can be supplied manually; optional MCP profiles must be selected explicitly. MCP discovery is not tool permission: managed tool calls need a separate exact allowlist and individual approval. S3 storage does not grant an agent file access. The bounded managed tool loop supports named OpenAI-compatible text models and manual runs only; exact allowlists and per-call approval remain separate.
history: Saved metadata below is not a live readiness check, and no connection is selected automatically. Editing connection configuration clears its previous test result.
missing: No valid saved AI or MCP profile is available. Use manual source text and an external client, or configure a profile first.
replace: Saving will REPLACE this agent’s saved skills and MCP references with the fields below, and disable its managed tool policy. No connection is preselected. Current model assignment is unchanged. Existing run/review invalidation guards still apply. Leave this page to cancel without changes.
